justification: Although some applicants have Article 11 complaints listed in the appendix, the Court's merits reasoning is confined to Article 3 ill-treatment, with Article 11 complaints disposed of by reference to well-established case-law under a generic paragraph without a standalone Article 11 merits analysis, and the remaining complaints (including Article 11) are not examined separately — meaning there is no genuine, coherent Article 11 merits adjudication in the judgment.
